name: Argentiferous-Skerry
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in towering mountain ranges. Travelers navigate by an ancient meteor crater and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Something scrubbed this biosphere clean within a geological instant. The rocks remember it as a thin black line.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.

For traders, solar potential, geothermal energy, uranium and platinum alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
